summary: The new `MvPowerSeries` difference-of-substitution lemmas and the height and `p`-series results are not in Mathlib or TauCeti, but `LeadingDifference.lean` copies the private leading-component scaffolding of `Logarithm/InfiniteHeight.lean` instead of sharing it. It also inlines an existing aeval bridge lemma.
